verdict.rationale: A is the only option that robustly supports both stated timing needs: it arrives early enough to provide a substantial buffer before the 3:30 p.m. panel and departs late enough after the 12:15 p.m. final session to allow a short closeout and airport transfer. B, C, and D each make at least one critical window unworkably tight, especially their return departures after the final session; C and D also leave very little arrival-day margin. A is nonstop and its Wanna Get Away Plus fare is an economy-cabin product consistent with the stated worksheet constraint.
